Short answers on colour

The questions we hear most at the counter, answered in a few lines.

How do I choose a lipstick shade for my skin tone?

Start with undertone. If gold jewellery flatters you, you likely have warm undertones and suit brick, coral and warm red shades. If silver looks better, you are probably cool and suit berry, plum and blue-red shades. If both work, you are neutral and can wear most shades, including Rosewood and Bordeaux.

What is the difference between a skin tint and foundation?

A skin tint is a light, sheer base that evens out tone and lets your skin show through. Foundation covers more and gives a uniform finish. Choose a tint for everyday wear and a natural look. Choose foundation when you want fuller coverage for events or photographs.

How do I stop cream blush fading?

Apply cream blush after your base and before powder. Tap it on with your fingertips and build in thin layers. Press a very light dusting of loose powder over it only if your skin runs oily. Cream formulas grip best on skin that is moisturised but not slick.

How do I find my undertone?

Look at the veins on your inner wrist in daylight. Green veins usually point to warm undertones, blue or purple to cool, and a mix of both to neutral. For a second check, hold a plain white sheet of paper next to your face. Skin that looks yellow suggests warm, and pink suggests cool.

Questions about orders

Delivery, returns, refills and ingredients. For anything else, write to hello@aurelle.example.

How much is delivery?

UK delivery is free on orders over £60. Below that it costs £4.95. Orders are packed within two working days and usually arrive one to three working days after that.

Do you deliver outside the UK?

At the moment we deliver within the United Kingdom only. International delivery is planned, and this page will be updated when it is available.

What is your returns policy?

You can return unopened products within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. For hygiene reasons we cannot take back lipstick, lip oil, mascara or any product that has been opened, unless it arrives faulty.

Are Aurelle products vegan and cruelty-free?

Yes. Every formula is vegan and contains no animal-derived ingredients. We do not test finished products or ingredients on animals.

Are the formulas fragrance-free?

Yes. We add no fragrance to any product. Some pigments and waxes have a faint natural smell, which fades within a minute of application.

How does the Rouge Satin refill work?

Rouge Satin comes in a refillable case. When a bullet is finished, you buy the Rouge Satin Refill in the same shade, pull out the empty insert and click the new one in. The case is designed to last for years.

How do I choose a skin tint shade?

Test the tint along your jawline in daylight. The three shades, Light 02, Medium 05 and Deep 08, are made to blend. If you sit between two, choose the lighter in winter and the deeper in summer.

About Aurelle

Aurelle is a luxury makeup brand based in London, United Kingdom. It makes refillable lipstick, lip oil, skin tint, cream blush, highlighter, eye colour, mascara and brow gel.

Prices run from £24 to £52. Every formula is vegan and fragrance-free, and each product is made in small batches so the range stays focused.
